title: Rafael and the Compass
author: Sebastian Zhou
blurb: Elodie Ashgrove, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the century turns.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
